fichas.title: Pitched Roofs
fichas.summary: Overview of pitched-roof spaces, roof insulation, and ventilated and non-ventilated construction. Formerly used as naturally ventilated hay lofts, roof spaces are now often converted into habitable rooms, requiring additional building-physics measures. The page describes roof-layer build-ups, ventilation gaps, insulation placement, vapour barriers, and example eaves and ridge details.
uses: Storage of harvested produce in traditional hay lofts
Conversion of roof spaces into habitable rooms
Protection from weather and condensation through roof construction
